nodes.description: Private uint256 _totalSupply tracking the total token supply of the Corra ERC20 token.
Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding token balances of each account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances holding spending approvals.
Constructor of Corra: sets name 'Corra' and symbol 'CORA' and mints 10000000 * 10 ** decimals() tokens to msg.sender.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount): debits _balances[account] and decreases _totalSupply.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): moves balances between accounts.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount): writes the _allowances mapping.
Public burn(uint256 amount) destroying tokens from _msgSender().
Public burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) destroying tokens from account using the caller's allowance.
msg.sender, the externally controlled address that receives the initial minted supply and drives _msgSender() based flows.
Arithmetic expression 10000000 * 10 ** decimals() used as the initial mint amount in the constructor.
Arithmetic state update _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic state update _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Arithmetic state update _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic state update currentAllowance - amount passed to _approve inside burnFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of the public burn function.
uint256 amount parameter of the public burnFrom function.
address account parameter of the public burnFrom function.
Local variable currentAllowance holding allowance(account, _msgSender()) in burnFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of the internal _mint function.
address account parameter of the internal _mint function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient argument when the constructor calls _mint.
The Corra constructor invokes the internal _mint routine during deployment.
The constructor evaluates the multiplication/power expression 10000000 * 10 ** decimals() to size the mint supply.
_mint performs the arithmetic state update _totalSupply += amount.
The _mint arithmetic update writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint credits the _balances mapping of the recipient account.
_burn performs the arithmetic state update _totalSupply -= amount.
The _burn arithmetic update writes the _totalSupply state variable.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount before updating balances.
The subtraction result is written back into the _balances mapping.
The public burn function delegates to the internal _burn function.
burnFrom computes currentAllowance - amount before calling _approve.
The reduced allowance value is written into the _allowances mapping via _approve.
burnFrom calls the internal _burn function after updating the allowance.
burnFrom reads the _allowances mapping through allowance() to compute currentAllowance.
The internal _approve function writes the _allowances state mapping.
The amount parameter flows into the burn function body before being forwarded to _burn.
The amount parameter flows into burnFrom and is compared against the allowance.
The account parameter flows into burnFrom and is used to read the allowance and burn tokens.
The local currentAllowance is the left operand of the subtraction producing the new allowance.
The amount parameter flows into _mint and is added to the recipient balance and total supply.
The account parameter flows into _mint and indexes the _balances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to supply the burn function's argument, so it is folded into the burn function node.
The amount parameter is consumed entirely inside burnFrom for the allowance check and burn call, so it merges into burnFrom.
The account parameter is only used within burnFrom to read the allowance and burn from that account, so it merges into burnFrom.
The local currentAllowance is directly the operand of the arithmetic subtraction currentAllowance - amount, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The amount parameter is used only inside _mint for supply and balance arithmetic, so it merges into the _mint function.
The account parameter is used only inside _mint as the _balances index, so it merges into the _mint function.
